purpose: Original detailed deck and below-deck reconstruction for the existing ordinary POTC family and both paint variants.

stock_contract.claim: Existing pinned stock-derived identity and total count only; no game interior coordinates known.

method: Museum and primary-plan catalogue research supplies arrangement vocabulary. All metre dimensions, room positions and access clearances are authored to the preserved hull. Public source text is paraphrased; no museum image, plan tracing or proprietary texture is distributed.

sources.title: Royal Museums Greenwich: Endymion (1797), ZAZ2228
sources.kind: Primary builder plan for the Admiralty
sources.observed: The museum identifies a 1:48 lower-deck plan of the 40-gun frigate Endymion, made by Randall, Brent and Sons.
sources.application: A continuous principal battery deck below the open upper waist, with after accommodation and real fore/aft access.
sources.limit: Endymion is a later 40-gun analogue; POTC family total remains 44 and its authored battery allocation is preserved.
sources.applies_to: A continuous principal battery deck below the open upper waist, with after accommodation and real fore/aft access.

sources.title: Association Hermione-La Fayette: Chirurgie Marine, deuxième partie
sources.observed: The article places the crew and surgeon in the between-deck space beneath the battery and above the hold, with temporary framed/canvas sick-berths and storage.
sources.application: Add a separate berth deck below the principal battery, with framed timber and a clear central passage.
sources.limit: Modern replica operation and later French practice are arrangement analogues; no claim about original game room locators.
sources.applies_to: Add a separate berth deck below the principal battery, with framed timber and a clear central passage.

sources.title: Association Hermione-La Fayette: Cloisonnement du faux-pont, la Sainte-Barbe
sources.observed: The account separates a partitioned after between-deck room from the powder magazine below it in the hold.
sources.application: A physically partitioned after store and lower powder store, with passage openings instead of a solid wall across the route.
sources.limit: Magazine and aft store are original static scenery; they are not interactive ammunition systems or exact Hermione room copies.
sources.applies_to: A physically partitioned after store and lower powder store, with passage openings instead of a solid wall across the route.

decisions.basis: One principal enclosed battery plus the preserved light upper extremity batteries give exactly 44 guns. The between-deck berth space and hold follow documented frigate hierarchy. The after cabin is abaft the last principal gun station; no second full principal battery is invented. This is an authored adaptation of the listed historical analogues to the unchanged game-family gun total.

decisions.feature: Physically separate lower levels and hold
decisions.basis: The authored hull contains distinct gun_deck_0, berth_lower and a framed hold. Numerical deck and floor baselines are fitted estimates; the source deck hierarchy supplies arrangement vocabulary rather than retail game coordinates.

decisions.feature: After cabin and unobstructed structural access
decisions.basis: The furnished after cabin has a real centered partition door opening from its own lower deck. The main hatch shaft reaches that level; no side stair crosses a cabin wall or opens into a sealed low quarterdeck space. Cabin dimensions and this access route are authored game-environment choices.

coordinate_system.longitudinal: s_fraction of preserved deck length, positive forward
coordinate_system.absolute_plan: x_m across ship, y_m up, forward_z_m positive bow
coordinate_system.note: Vertical z_m fields follow the existing Blender builder convention; longitudinal at/from/to are fractions.
